data.name: Mission Bay Bike Tour
data.headline: Resort Guests Only | Complimentary | Wednesdays & Sundays | 10am | Age 12+
data.description:
Enjoy a bike ride along beautiful Mission Bay! You will ride off property to see dramatic downtown skyline views, beach town vibes, and if we get lucky some wild marine life! 
_________
data.what_is_included:
Bike Rental, Water Bottle, Tour Guide, Helmet (ages 12+)
__________
data.what_to_bring:
You may bring your own water, but we will provide as well.
_________
data.cancellation_summary: Please email the Recreation Department at recreation@paradisepoint.com to inform us of your cancellation.
data.cancellation_notes:
Cancellations made at least 24 hours in advance are eligible for a full refund or credit. If we need to cancel your reservation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances, you will also receive a full refund or credit.

**To cancel or inquire about your reservation, please contact us by phone 619-247-9345**. No-shows and cancellations made within 24 hours of the reservation will be charged in full.
data.booking_notes:
You're all set.

Head over to the Island Adventure Hut (bike rentals hut near Island Market) 15 minutes prior to event start time. A helmet is required for all riders under the age of 18. A waiver must be signed by all participants.

1 Hour Bike Ride | 5 people max

Please cancel 24 hours in advance by replying to this email.
data.check_in_details:
Please come 10 minutes early to fill out a waiver and get sized for a bicycle.
_____________

All Riders must be ages 12 or older.
data.special_requirements:
Ages 12+ Participants must be comfortable riding a bicycle. Terrain includes bridges, hills, streets, and flat boardwalk surfaces.
_____________
data.restrictions: Anyone under the age 12 will not be able to join the tour. riders must have closed toed shoes.
